# PVC-AEAD-0 Candidate A1 / v0.2.0 Test Vectors

The retained machine-readable corpus is `vectors/PVC_AEAD0_VECTORS_0.1.0.csv`. Its 48 vectors already use separately generated encryption and authentication key values and remains byte-identical in Candidate A1.

## Canonical independent-key vector: `abc`

This is the primary copy-and-implement vector for the supported two-key profile.

```text
K_enc:  000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f
K_mac:  808182838485868788898a8b8c8d8e8f909192939495969798999a9b9c9d9e9f
Nonce:  000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000
AD:     empty
P:      616263
Tag:    256 bits
C:      a10b4d
T:      a16ff4b4dd13b48bab0701cd8a67f1248ebb4bf37a3146931f04e08c834d5cee
```

The two keys are distinct fixed KAT values. Fixed vectors demonstrate reproducibility only; real keys must be independently generated with adequate entropy.

## Legacy equal-key diagnostic vector

The v0.1.0 all-zero result is retained only to show that the construction bytes did not change:

```text
K_enc:  all zero
K_mac:  all zero
Nonce:  all zero
AD:     empty
P:      616263
Tag:    256 bits
C:      84db1c
T:      44996790c712f273337c0195b2f9b2ea3cf04afeafd03fa50835d00b9615cda8
```

Using the same key value in both roles is outside the security reduction and must not be copied as an operational keying pattern.

## Candidate A1 independent differential corpus

```text
File: vectors/PVC_AEAD0_DIFFERENTIAL_A1.csv
Cases: 4096
SHA-256: f7680e58373fd903dfb51ca500455cf1cee6c858b2e1909b01623086b68acdb8
```

The corpus records independent role keys, nonce, tag profile, associated data,
plaintext, every used stream frame, used keystream bytes, ciphertext,
authentication context, and tag. It is generated by
`pvc-aead0-independent-differential` from a fixed reproducibility seed.

The retained 48-vector KAT corpus fingerprint is:

```text
SHA-256: a40d691d9d3296d86dea1b9183889d650f780b3f2964b84c45a2e1939e171fa7
```
